company_type: UK-Indian carbon-capture scaleup with strong Indian R&D presence

technology.technology_name: CycloneCC — Modular Carbon Capture (Rotating Packed Bed + APBS Solvent)
technology.description: Carbon Clean's CycloneCC uses a proprietary combination of APBS (Amine Promoted Buffer Salt) solvents and rotating packed bed (RPB) technology to capture CO2 from industrial flue gas at 100% modular footprint roughly 10x smaller than conventional absorber-column carbon capture systems. Target sectors: cement, steel, refineries, lime.
technology.problem_solved: Cement is ~7–8% of global CO2 emissions. Conventional CCUS has prohibitive capex and footprint — CycloneCC reduces both opex and capex by up to 50% and the on-site footprint by ~90%.
technology.innovation_summary: RPB technology applied to PSA-like carbon capture is novel; APBS solvent reduces regeneration energy.
technology.unique_selling_points: 10x smaller footprint; 50% lower opex/capex; modular and scalable; backed by Chevron, Saudi Aramco, Marubeni
technology.application_area: Cement kilns (primary), steel mills, refineries, lime plants, biogas upgrading
technology.target_industries: Cement majors (UltraTech, ACC, Ambuja, Dalmia, Shree), steel (Tata Steel, JSW), refineries (Reliance, IOC)
technology.potential_customers: UltraTech (already in talks with multiple Indian cement majors per company disclosures), Shree Cement, JSW
technology.trl_level: 7 (System prototype demonstrated in operational environment — Tata Steel UK installation, Aramco)
technology.patent_status: Multiple granted patents in UK, US, EU; PCT filings
technology.patent_jurisdiction: GB primary; US, EP, PCT; IN pursued
technology.wipo_green_listed: Eligible — strong fit for WIPO Green carbon capture category
technology.estimated_market_size: Global carbon capture market projected at $4–6B by 2030; India share growing with CBAM pressure
technology.preferred_license_type: Patent Buyout (territorial exclusivity) for Indian cement majors
technology.certification_status: ISO 9001/14001; equipment to ATEX/IECEx where applicable
